description: Ring 0 sweep coverage (Catylist ADR-0000 and ADR-0010). A repository is added here when it adopts ADR-0000, after the ruleset-sandbox trial. standing_adr maps a repository to bot logins whose automated pull requests are covered by a standing ADR (Code, Law 1). automation_publishing lists workflow-owned automation/ branches that ring-0 may open pull requests for (Catylist ADR-0012): exactly one GitHub-signed commit by an allowed bot, touching only the listed paths.
